slides.title: civil servants in Tigray unpaid since March
Mekelle is reopening
slides.body: Shops and banks are opening again, Al Jazeera reports, but residents remain anxious.

slides.title: “Our problems are not over”
slides.body: “Things may be reopening, but that does not mean our problems are over,” Gebregziabher, a public servant in Mekelle, told Al Jazeera.

slides.title: students applied for temporary placements
slides.body: at universities outside Tigray, under an Education Ministry programme.

slides.title: Pay workers. Keep students learning. Keep the peace.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
